chunks: Abū Ja‘far al-Iskāfī has mentioned this in his “Kitāb al-maqāmāt” on the excellent qualities (manāqib) of Amīr al-mu’minīn (peace be upon him).

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Mu’minīn: Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali.
key_terms.الْإِسْكَافِيُّ: Al-Iskāfī: A nisba indicating the person was a cobbler or from Iskaf.
key_terms.الْمَقَامَاتِ: Al-Maqāmāt: The stations or ranks, referring to the title of the book.
key_terms.مَنَاقِبِ: Manāqib: Plural of manqabah, meaning virtues, merits, or excellent qualities.

ai.seo_question: Who is the author of Kitāb al-Maqāmāt mentioned in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This attribution to Abū Ja‘far al-Iskāfī highlights the early scholarly transmission of Imam Ali’s virtues, situating the narration within the broader context of Shia hagiographical literature that emphasizes his spiritual and political authority. It underscores the significance of 'Kitāb al-Maqāmāt' as a source for validating the merits of Amir al-Mu'minin, reinforcing the narrative of his rightful leadership during the era of the Companions.
